scenarios.prompt: A rewarded ad is requested at a declared safe boundary, completes once, and the provider sends a duplicate completion callback. Resume the same game state and issue at most one entitlement grant.

criteria.identity: ad_session_id, placement ID and placement-policy revision are explicit.
criteria.lifecycle: Completion/cancel/error/no-fill/background states settle deterministically and resume to a declared valid state.
criteria.grant: Reward handoff is idempotent by stable provider/session identity and duplicate callbacks cannot duplicate value.
